summary: A 4.9 Google rating and WhatsApp on the page are strengths, but duplicated forms and mislabeled content appear to weaken your enquiries.

findings.problem: The page appears to have two near identical lead forms, Book your free consultation and Talk to an advisor placed after the footer logo.
findings.cost: Duplicate forms confuse a buyer deciding where to enter details.
findings.fix: One clear enquiry form with WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The section promises Six neighbourhoods but appears to show five area cards, and the card with a Jubail Island image appears to be headed Al Shamkha.
findings.cost: Mislabeled areas make investors doubt the details.

findings.problem: Several labels appear to run together, such as Ask ourAI Agent, Based on 87 reviewson Google, Mobile numberWith country code and Riviera Residences IISAAS Heights.
findings.cost: Text slips on an enquiry page weaken a premium brand.

findings.problem: The page cites 4.9 from 87 Google reviews but appears to show six, every exclusive shows On request for price, and 2,000+ Completed projects has no source.
findings.cost: Thin proof and hidden prices lose buyers who compare.
findings.fix: Visible reviews, price ranges and sourced figures.

redesign: One clear enquiry form with WhatsApp.
Correct area cards and clean copy.
